kind: Derived publication dossier. Original non-blind, same-assistant judgments; no automatic semantic detection. State fragments are deliberately corrupted fixtures or selected valid controls, never live state. Full-source file hashes identify the original frozen bundle, which is in the separately supplied full archive. A quotation fragment alone cannot establish absence elsewhere in a whole file.
